claim: RAG beats fine-tuning, and LongAlign improves long tasks but hurts short ones.

statements.text: RAG outperforms domain fine-tuning at injecting domain knowledge into language models.

evidence.title: Fine-Tuning or Retrieval? Comparing Knowledge Injection in LLMs
evidence.quote: RAG consistently outperforms it, both for existing knowledge encountered during training and entirely new knowledge

evidence.title: Domain Fine-Tuning vs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Multiple-Choice Question Answering
evidence.quote: domain knowledge encoded in weights dominates domain knowledge supplied in context

statements.text: LongAlign improves performance on long context tasks by up to 30%.

evidence.title: LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models
evidence.quote: LongAlign outperforms existing recipes for LLMs in long context tasks by up to 30\%

statements.text: LongAlign degrades performance on short, generic tasks.

dropped_quotes.quote: LongAlign clearly harms proficiency in short generic tasks
